## Data preparation

```{r import}
# Downloading the sample count matrix and metadata
counts <- read.csv("~/Documents/Final Project-1/counts.csv", 
                   row.names = 1, 
                   check.names = FALSE)
meta   <- read.csv("~/Documents/Final Project-1/meta_data.csv")


```

## Gene selection and Summary statistics

```{r select-gene}

# Creating a function to-
# validate selected gene and fix ID versions
fix_ensembl_ids <- function(gene_list, counts) {
  sapply(gene_list, function(g) {
    if (g %in% rownames(counts)) {
      return(g)
    } else {
      hits <- grep(g, rownames(counts), value = TRUE)
      if (length(hits) > 0) {
        return(hits[1])
      } else {
        return(NA)
      }
    }
  })
}

# Selecting gene "ENSG00000153563"  from the list
# This is the gene CD8A which is marker for cytotoxic T cells
gene1 <- "ENSG00000153563"

# Now, validating the selected ensembl ID
gene1 <- fix_ensembl_ids(gene1, counts)
gene1

# Extracting counts for this from all samples
gene1_counts <- as.numeric(counts[gene1, ])

head(gene1_counts)
length(gene1_counts)

# Generating summary statistics

   # changing row names into columns
   gene1_long <- counts %>%
   rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
   # filtering only for selected gene
   filter(gene == gene1) %>%
   # converting wide to long data format
   pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "count"
   )

   summary_stats <- gene1_long%>%
    summarise(
    mean   = mean(count),
    median = median(count),
    sd     = sd(count),
    min    = min(count),
    max    = max(count)
  )
   
summary_stats   

# Save as CSV
write.csv(summary_stats, "summary_statistics_CD8A", row.names = FALSE)  


```

```{r scatterplot}

# Generating scatterplot using gene1 and 2nd gene

# Selecting ENSG00000188389 as the 2nd gene
# This gene(PDCD1) codes PD1
  gene2 <- "ENSG00000188389"

# Validating the ensembl ID
gene2 <- fix_ensembl_ids(gene2, counts)
gene2

# Extracting counts for this from all samples
  gene2_counts <- as.numeric(counts[gene2, ])
  head(gene2_counts)
  length(gene2_counts) 
  
# Changing row names into columns
  gene2_long <- counts %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  #filtering only for selected gene
  filter(gene == gene2) %>%
  #converting wide to long data format
   pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "count"
   )
 
# Adding metadata to both genes
gene1_meta <- gene1_long %>%
  left_join(meta, by = c("sample" = "barcode"))

gene2_meta <- gene2_long %>%
  left_join(meta, by = c("sample" = "barcode"))

    
# Renaming
gene1_cln <- gene1_meta %>% rename(gene1_count = count)
gene2_cln <- gene2_meta %>% rename(gene2_count = count)

# Joining the genes
scatter_df <- left_join(gene1_cln, gene2_cln, by = c("sample", "paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50"))

# Now generating the plot
ggplot(scatter_df, aes(
  x = gene1_count, 
  y = gene2_count,
  color = paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  #because the range of the counts is huge,
  #transforming the axes into log
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "CD8A vs PDCD1 Expression Colored by Molecular Subtype",
    x = "CD8A Counts",
    y = "PDCD1 Counts",
    color = "Subtype"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```

```{r heatmap}
## Generating Heatmaps
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# 1. Selecting 10 genes focussed on tumor microenvironment
selected_genes <- c(
  "ENSG00000153563",
  "ENSG00000172116",
  "ENSG00000198851",
  "ENSG00000100453",
  "ENSG00000180644",
  "ENSG00000188389",
  "ENSG00000120217",
  "ENSG00000163599",
  "ENSG00000089692",
  "ENSG00000049768"
)

# 2. Now, validating the ensemble IDs
selected_genes <- fix_ensembl_ids(selected_genes, counts)
selected_genes

# 3. Extracting count for these genes
heatmap_mat <- counts[selected_genes, ]
heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_mat)

# 4. Generating gene names for the rows
gene_names <- c("CD8A", "CD8B", "CD3E",
               "GZMB", "PRF1", "PDCD1",
               "CD274", "CTLA4", "LAG3", "FOXP3")

# 5. Log transform
heatmap_mat <- log2(heatmap_mat + 1)

# 6. Applying z score scale
heatmap_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_mat)))

# 7. Replacing row names with gene names
rownames(heatmap_scaled) <- gene_names

# 8. Prepare metadata for annotation
meta2 <- meta %>%
  select(barcode, paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50) %>%
  filter(barcode %in% colnames(heatmap_scaled)) %>%
  arrange(match(colnames(heatmap_scaled), barcode))

# 9. Creating the annotation bar
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Subtype = meta2$paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50,
  col = list(Subtype = c(
    "LumA"   = "#4DBEEE",
  "LumB"   = "#EDB120",
  "Her2"   = "#D95319",
  "Basal"  = "#7E2F8E",
  "Normal" = "#77AC30",
  "NA"     = "grey70"
  )),
  which = "column",
  height = unit(0.6, "cm")
)

# 10. Generating heat map
Heatmap(
  heatmap_scaled,
  name = "Z-score",
  top_annotation = ha,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  col = colorRamp2(
         c(-2, 0, 2), 
         c("#4575b4", "white", "#d73027")),
  border = TRUE
)

```

```{r volcano plot}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Log-transforming the counts counts
log_counts <- log2(counts + 1)

# 2. Defining High vs Low groups using CD8A median (already calculated above)
cd8a_median <- summary_stats$median[1]
group_labels <- ifelse(gene1_counts > cd8a_median, "High", "Low")
names(group_labels) <- colnames(counts)

high_samples <- names(group_labels)[group_labels == "High"]
low_samples  <- names(group_labels)[group_labels == "Low"]

# 3. Computing fold change
mean_high <- rowMeans(log_counts[, high_samples])
mean_low  <- rowMeans(log_counts[, low_samples])
FC <- mean_high - mean_low

# 4. Computing p-values
pvals <- apply(log_counts, 1, function(x)
  t.test(x[high_samples], x[low_samples])$p.value
)

# 5. Building volcano dataframe
volcano_df <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(counts),
  FC = FC,
  pval = pvals,
  neglog10 = -log10(pvals)
)
volcano_df <- as.data.frame(volcano_df)

# 6. Cleaning the Ensembl IDs (removing version numbers)
volcano_df$ensembl_clean <- sub("\\..*", "", volcano_df$gene)

# 7. Mapping Ensembl IDs to Gene Symbol
volcano_df$symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = volcano_df$ensembl_clean,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

# 8. Adding significance categories
volcano_df <- volcano_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      pval < 0.1 & FC > 0.5  ~ "Up in CD8A-High",
      pval < 0.1 & FC < -0.5 ~ "Down in CD8A-High",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

# 9. Selecting top 5 up and downregulated genes (remove NA symbols first)
top_up <- volcano_df %>%
  filter(sig != "Not Significant") %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol)) %>%        # <-- prevents ggrepel crash
  arrange(pval) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:5)

top_down <- volcano_df %>%
  filter(sig == "Down in CD8A-High", !is.na(symbol)) %>%
  arrange(pval) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:5)

top_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)

# 10. Generating Volcano plot
ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = FC, y = neglog10)) +
  
  # Base points
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
  
  # Label top genes
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_genes,
    aes(label = symbol),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  
  # Threshold lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up in CD8A-High" = "red",
      "Down in CD8A-High" = "forestgreen",
      "Not Significant" = "grey60"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: High vs Low CD8A Expression",
    subtitle = "Top 5 Upregulated and Downregulated Genes",
    x = "Fold Change (High - Low)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    color = "Significance"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```
